MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  INTERNATIONAL FRIENDSHIP COMMISSION
  June 9, 2026

Chair Carbajal called the meeting to order at 5:05 p.m. in Conference Room 4, Norwalk
City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll call were
Chair Carbajal, Vice Chair Gomez, Commissioner Flores, and Commissioner Salas. Also,
present were Jesus Gomez, City Manager, Amber Bulosan, Management Analyst, and
Svetlana Hernandez, Office Assistant I.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Chair Carbajal motioned for the approval of the minutes of the International Friendship
Commission Regular Meeting minutes that was held on March 10, 2026. Commissioner
Salas seconded the motion.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Chair Carbajal, Vice  Chair  Gomez,  Commissioner  Flores,
  Commissioner Salas
NOES:  None
ABSENT: None
ABSTAIN: None

REPORTS

Potential Programs and Partnerships

The Commission discussed the possibilities of potential Sister Cities; Vice Chair Gomez
presented his idea. The Commissioners also discussed how they can establish programs
and partnerships, through outreach of the community, like at City events.

Recap of Sister Cities International Southern California Quarterly Regional Meeting
March 28, 2026

Ms. Bulosan gave a recap at the meeting and discussed how various organizations were
talking about the connections they have made with their sister cities. It was also discussed
that many cities/organizations start with Friendship Cities first, to build connections before
committing to a Sister City. Commissioners were also invited to attend the webinars
hosted by International Sister Cities.
 STAFF COMMENTS

Independence Day Celebration – July 3, 2026

Staff invited the Commission to attend the Independence Day Festival. This would serve
as an opportunity to engage with the community and get their feedback on possible
cultural exchanges. Commissioners were excited and will be provided with times of the
event.

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

The next regular meeting to be held on Tuesday, July 14, 2026 will be cancelled, and a
special meeting will be scheduled for Thursday, July 23, 2026.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No public comment

ADJOURNMENT:

Being no further business to come before the International Friendship Commission, the
meeting was adjourned at 6:17 p.m.

_______________________________
CHAIR
Maria Carbajal
